name: Miniflux
author: Aurelien Navarre
description: Read the latest unread items from a Miniflux instance and mark them read without leaving the bar.

barWidget.description: Shows the latest unread Miniflux entries, opens them in the browser and marks them read.

schema.label: Entries to show
schema.description: How many entries the panel lists, 1 to 100. Also reachable from the panel's Settings section.

schema.label: Refresh every (minutes)
schema.description: How often the list refreshes on its own: 30 minutes, 1, 2, 3, 6, 12 or 24 hours.

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: How large the panel's text reads: small, medium, large or xlarge (extra large).

schema.label: Mark new entries on the bar
schema.description: Puts a dot on the bar icon when a refresh brings in entries you have not seen yet.

schema.label: Unread entries only
schema.description: Off also lists entries you have already read.
